stories.title: Security firm linked to ICE crackdown in US reports UK revenue slump after asylum centre contract ends
stories.summary: A private security company linked to Donald Trump’s immigration crackdown reported a slump in UK revenues after losing an asylum centre contract. MTC provided security at the heavily criticised Manston centre in Kent and could now make £500m managing the site until 2036. The cessation of the contract last September pushed MTC UK to a £1.6m loss, compared with a profit of £1.3m in 2024. The new UK small boats contract is worth an initial £462m but could be worth as much as £539m if it is extended to last 10 years.

stories.title: About 900,000 Origin Energy customers affected by hack as company admits it was warned weeks before public told
stories.summary: Origin Energy has admitted it was warned of the hack that accessed 900,000 current and former customers’ personal data three weeks before it first made the data breach public. The company has 4.8m customer accounts in Australia, providing electricity, fossil gas, LPG and internet services to homes and businesses. Chief executive Frank Calabria warned customers to watch out for suspicious activity and a heightened risk of scams. The company is under active investigation regarding the criminal matter of the data breach.
